ambient: Something is announced in a language made of colour.
The far side gets one degree louder and stays there.
description: A small bright space with a great deal of arrangement in it, and the sense of a much larger room behind a wall that is busy becoming a door. You are being announced. Whatever is doing the announcing is fond of you and is getting it right.
name: The Antechamber

looks: Everything here has been put where it is, recently, for your arrival.
It is not decoration. It is preparation.
It rearranges while you look at it, and improves.
objects.name: the arrangement

looks: It is not opening. It is being rewritten into the kind of thing that opens.
A great deal is happening on the far side and all of it is expecting you.
It will be finished in a moment. It has been a moment.
objects.name: the wall that is becoming a door

weather: It is bright and dry, and the brightness has a direction and no source.
